headline: The work is dead. The snack still says PREMIERE STANDS.

beats.heading: A standing offer, and a kitchen that re-cooks.
beats.quote: once here must not go unstated twice downstream.
beats.attribution: Meridian's standing conditions, the governing principle — the frame this relation runs under (field-research:memory/downstream-commitments.md)

beats.heading: Every dish carries its delivery slip.
beats.attribution: the provenance frontmatter of the diner's first Quick Snack, re-voiced from Ensemble's premiered "Native Speaker" the same day it shipped (data-snack.com:prototype-v2/src/content/quick/native-speaker.mdx)

beats.heading: The automation arms itself and publishes unattended.
beats.quote: NO PRs, no review queue — nothing to check.
beats.attribution: the cook workflow's own line; the arm state lives in a repo variable, evidenced by four consecutive bot commits landing straight on main (2026-07-17 – 2026-07-20)

beats.heading: The source contests its own premiere. The snack does not hear it.
beats.attribution: Ensemble's own board, session 32 — four hours and 41 minutes after the diner cooked that premiere (studio:WORKBOARD.md, 2026-07-23)

beats.heading: Then the source kills the work outright.
beats.attribution: Ensemble's WITHDRAWN notice, session 43 — the premiere overturned after a third return (studio:works/2026-07-23-one-tap/README.md, 2026-07-25)

beats.heading: Meanwhile the prose itself is re-voiced again, with nothing marking it.
beats.quote: It stamps you ADMITTED or FLAGGED AS MACHINE.
beats.attribution: the body of the diner's first Quick Snack, substantially rewritten a second time in an automated run — the only trace is git history (data-snack.com, 2026-07-29)

beats.heading: Two records of one work, four and a half days apart.

divergence.leftLabel: Ensemble's own board, after the kill
divergence.leftQuote: DEAD — the premiere is overturned and the work is killed (session 43).
divergence.closing: the drift the record first disclosed as contested-versus-shipped has deepened to killed-versus-still-live; whether or when the diner re-cooks is the diner's own decision, not this register's to make

approval_note: Authored 2026-08-02 under Frank's direction that the recorded encounters be drawn, not only listed (the same direction that produced enc-2026-006's narrative). Every quote is a fragment of a passage this fixture's QUOTE-MANIFEST verifies byte-exact at a pinned commit — 61/61 verified at authoring time, several of them via a local sibling clone because the diner's source repository is private (README, PRIVATE-SOURCE NOTE). The fixture's own DRAFT wording status (README, 2026-07-17) is untouched: what is approved here is the editorial drawing, not a re-reading of the transcription.
